transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. Lee. Well, I guess I'm here because most days I wake up already feeling like there's this heavy, gray weight sitting on me. And I just can't shake it. Even when I’m out working with the crew, or at home around my kids, I have this low, hollow feeling. It's just... like I’m just going through the motions every single day.
Can you tell me how long you've been feeling this way—days, weeks, months, or longer?

It's been a lot longer than a few months. I'd say... it's been going on for about three years and three months now. It started right around the time the groundskeeping contract changed our schedule at work. The longer days just kind of took over my life, and I've felt this way ever since.
During these past three years, have there been any stretches—say, two months or more—where that heavy, gray feeling completely lifted and you felt like your normal self again?

No, not really. I mean... there hasn't been any time where it just went away completely. Not for two months, anyway. Maybe a day here or there where it wasn't quite as heavy, but... no, it's pretty much been there the whole time.
During these three years, has there ever been a stretch where your mood or other symptoms got noticeably worse than your usual baseline, almost like hitting a new low?

No, I don't think so. It hasn't really dropped into a new low, mostly because... well, it's just always this bad. It's just a steady, heavy feeling day in and day out. I haven't noticed a stretch where it got suddenly worse, it just never gets any better.
